findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_blog_articles" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lists StatutoryLetters' published articles explaining UK statutory rights and escalation routes, covering SEND and EHCP timescales, tenancy deposit protection, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_letter_types, get_organisational_letters · Public sink: list_letter_types, get_organisational_letters, list_blog_articles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_letter_types, get_organisational_letters · Public sink: list_letter_types, get_organisational_letters, list_blog_articles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
